name: Havixbeck (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, green and white with a broad green middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Havixbeck (a black hawk on white above green).
history: Municipal flag of Havixbeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Havixbeck arms — hawk on white above green
